title: Unsafe deserialization via YAML.unsafe_load (ruby) — review required
description: The ruby call YAML.unsafe_load rebuilds objects from a byte stream without a type allowlist, so the payload itself chooses which classes are constructed. Prefer a data-only format; when a native serializer is required, pass an explicit allowlist (YAML.safe_load). This lexical rule flags the call and does not resolve where the bytes come from.
remediation: Replace YAML.unsafe_load with a data-only parser, or constrain the accepted types (YAML.safe_load).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the YAML.unsafe_load call; origin of the bytes and the reachable classes are out of scope.
